12.t: Working with data: elements in the Earth’s crust
q: Which element is most common in the crust?
Which is the most common metal?
Calculate the total percentage of the two most common elements.
Aluminium is more common than iron, but people used iron for thousands of years first. Suggest why.
Aluminium is more reactive, so it is held tightly in its compounds and needs electrolysis to extract; iron can be extracted by heating with carbon.
